note: Gameplay rigs (not house geometry). SpecGreybox.Traps (Assets/Editor/Traps.cs) builds them AFTER the build's gates have run, on the Ignore Raycast layer, so no walk/seam/clash/props check sees them. Design and sources: docs/paint-can-trap.md.

paint_cans.name: paint_can_1
paint_cans.source: Film 10700/10702/10730: the rope is wrapped round the upstairs gallery handrail (the rail over flight 1, spec geometry.json upstairs rail at x 5.647); 10706/10708: the can swings down flight 1 toward the foyer; 10710-10724: it meets a bandit facing up the flight, face height, about the 4th-6th step, and he falls back to the foyer floor. z = the flight's walk line (spec stair walk_path z 10.83). This is Marv's can (10706-10714): silver, white-painted lid, red paint over the rim in drips, a blue label panel. Its knot is the LEFT one seen from the stair (10700/10702/10730: knots at x 860 and 1015 px of 1920, two balusters between them, baluster pitch ~95 px: 1.63 pitches = 0.19 m at our rail's 0.116 m pitch); image right = spec +z, so this can is at the flight's walk line (10.83) - 0.095. Can: US 1-gallon (6.5 in x 7.5 in), 3.785 L latex paint at ~1.3 kg/L + 0.3 kg can. Rope: 5/16 in (8 mm) cotton line (film: white braided cord). Oct 16 walk note (user): 'slightly lower': the can's centre at the bottom of the arc moved from 1.65 to 1.55 m above the step-4 tread (rope +0.10 m: mouth/chin of a 1.80 m adult). Model: tools/house/hifi_paint_can.py (PaintCan.glb). Colours sampled from film 10708 (hue-classified pixels on the can: red paint srgb 125/53/55, blue label 95/106/143, white lid 167/163/161) scaled x1.30 so the lid is albedo 0.85; the can's bare metal is authored silver 0.78.

paint_cans.name: paint_can_2
paint_cans.source: Harry's can (10700 on the rail, 10716-10724 hits him): cream-painted can with a wide blue 'SATIN' label and cream runs down its front (10722). Rope: the RIGHT knot (spec +z), 0.19 m from can 1 (see paint_can_1). Its length cannot be read from the film (the cord runs out of frame in 10720/10722; no frame shows both knot and can with a ruler): same length as can 1, it meets Harry's head on the same lower steps (10724). Colours (PaintCanSatin.glb) sampled x1.30 like can 1: label srgb 32/70/87 (10722), cream paint 143/128/87 (10722), can body 140/122/96 (10700).

dummy.source: Adult bandit test body (spec bodies.bandit is 1.85 x 0.55 for the door walks; 1.80 m is the brief's adult). Climb speed 0.6 m/s along the flight (~2 steps/s at the 0.295 m going).

keys: P pulls BOTH cans back to the release pose (held); L lets go Marv's (paint_can_1), K lets go Harry's (paint_can_2); B the dummy climbs; T resets everything. The film's order: L (Marv), then K (Harry).
